"""Main-only cache512 icpx compile OR one caps query bracketed by integer health."""
import argparse
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from cache_support import B, P, PCI, CacheRun, caps, closed, exact, load, need, packet, pin, sha


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--main-reviewed', action='store_true', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--mode', choices=('compile', 'query'), required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--qualification', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--qualification-sha256', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--compile-receipt', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--compile-receipt-sha256')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode == 'query':
        need(args.compile_receipt is not None and args.compile_receipt_sha256 is not None, 'actual compile pin required')
    common, policy, pins = packet()
    qpath = exact(dict(path=str(args.qualification), sha256=args.qualification_sha256))
    q = load(qpath)
    need(q['status'] == 'passed' and q['main_reviewed'] is True and
         q['binaries'] == policy.BINARIES and q['production_source_pins'] == load(P / 'production-source-pins.json')['source_pins'],
         'Main actual original official-long source/binary qualification')
    engine = q['engines']['official']
    env = policy.environment('official', False, engine['extra_runtime_dirs'])
    need(engine['extra_runtime_dirs'] == [], 'exact requested extra[] environment')
    common.source_stable(q['production_source_pins'])
    for item in q['binaries'].values():
        exact(item)
    for item in engine['mapped_libraries'].values():
        exact(item)
    for item in engine['health_libraries'].values():
        exact(item)
    source = P / 'health_caps.cpp'
    run = CacheRun(args.output, 420 if args.mode == 'compile' else 240)
    r = run.r
    r.update(compiler_provider='installed-icpx-2026.1', controller_source_pins=pins,
             engine_binary=q['binaries']['official'], source_pins=q['production_source_pins']['official'],
             original_qualification=pin(qpath), property_source=pin(source), reset_executed=False, retry_count=0,
             property_model_inference_tested=False)
    cursor = None
    def kernel(label, arguments):
        text, _ = run.run(label, ['/usr/bin/journalctl', '-k', '--no-pager', '-o', 'json', *arguments])
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines()]
        need(len(rows) <= 65536, 'bounded journal entries')
        relevant = [row for row in rows if PCI in row.get('MESSAGE', '') or re.search(r'\bxe\b', row.get('MESSAGE', ''))]
        from protocol import FAULT
        faults = [row for row in relevant if FAULT.search(row.get('MESSAGE', ''))]
        dump = (Path('/sys/bus/pci/devices') / PCI / 'devcoredump').exists()
        r[label] = dict(relevant_entries=relevant, fault_entries=faults, dump_present=dump)
        run.save()
        need(not faults and not dump, 'fresh kernel/device fault gate')
    def device(label):
        text, _ = run.run(label + '-list', ['/usr/bin/xpu-smi', 'discovery', '-j'])
        rows = json.loads(text)['device_list']
        need(len(rows) == 1 and type(rows[0]['device_id']) is int and rows[0]['device_id'] == 0, 'one index0 device')
        text, _ = run.run(label + '-selected', ['/usr/bin/xpu-smi', 'discovery', '-d', '0', '-j'])
        value = json.loads(text)
        need(type(value['device_id']) is int and value['device_id'] == 0 and value['pci_bdf_address'] == PCI and
             value['device_state'] == 'normal' and value['pci_device_id'] == '0xe20c' and value['pci_vendor_id'] == '0x8086',
             'independent actual xpu native ID/vendor/BDF/root index')
        text, _ = run.run(label + '-usage', ['/usr/bin/xpu-smi', 'stats', '-d', '0', '-j'])
        stats = json.loads(text)
        need(type(stats['device_index']) is int and stats['device_index'] == 0 and stats['pci_bdf'] == PCI and
             set(stats['memory']['used_mib']) == {'tile_0'}, 'exact memory telemetry')
        metric = stats['memory']['used_mib']['tile_0']
        need(set(metric) == {'avg', 'min', 'max', 'current'} and
             all(type(v) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in metric.values()) and
             metric['min'] <= metric['avg'] <= metric['max'] and
             metric['min'] <= metric['current'] <= metric['max'] and metric['current'] <= 256, 'fresh used<=256MiB')
        r[label] = dict(discovery=value, stats=stats)
        run.save()
    def health(label):
        binary = exact(engine['health_binary'])
        r['gpu_executed'] = True
        r['integer_health_workload_attempts'] = r.get('integer_health_workload_attempts', 0) + 1
        run.save()
        text, error = run.run(label, [str(binary), PCI], env, wall=45)
        lines = text.splitlines()
        need(lines[:6] == policy.HEALTH_LINES and all(line.startswith('LIBRARY ') for line in lines[6:]), 'unchanged six-record integer health')
        names = {line.removeprefix('LIBRARY ') for line in lines[6:]}
        need(names == set(engine['health_libraries']) and env['UR_ADAPTERS_FORCE_LOAD'] in names, 'actual native provider health maps')
        for item in engine['health_libraries'].values():
            exact(item)
        from protocol import diagnostics
        need(not diagnostics(error)['severe_messages'], 'no selected health runtime error')
    error = None
    try:
        if args.mode == 'compile':
            original = closed(load(B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-icpx-build-root-v2/record.json'))
            for path, digest in original['compiler_installed_pins'].items():
                exact(dict(path=path, sha256=digest))
            compiler = policy.ICPX / 'bin/icpx'
            need(str(compiler) in original['compiler_installed_pins'], 'actual pinned original compiler')
            run.run('compiler-version', [str(compiler), '--version'], env, wall=30)
            run.run('compile', [str(compiler), '-std=c++20', '-fsycl', '-O2', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror',
                               str(source), '-lze_loader', '-o', str(args.output / 'health_caps')],
                    env, wall=300, cpu=360, rss=8 << 30)
            r['property_binary'] = pin(args.output / 'health_caps')
            r['original_build_receipt'] = pin(B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-icpx-build-root-v2/record.json')
            r['compile_only_zero_gpu'] = True
        else:
            compiled_path = exact(dict(path=str(args.compile_receipt), sha256=args.compile_receipt_sha256))
            compiled = closed(load(compiled_path))
            need(compiled.get('compile_only_zero_gpu') is True and compiled['gpu_executed'] is False and
                 compiled['property_source'] == r['property_source'] and compiled['compiler_provider'] == r['compiler_provider'], 'actual new property build')
            binary = exact(compiled['property_binary'])
            r['property_binary'], r['property_build_receipt'] = compiled['property_binary'], pin(compiled_path)
            kernel('kernel-before', ['-b'])
            text, _ = run.run('cursor', ['/usr/bin/journalctl', '-k', '-n', '0', '--show-cursor', '--no-pager'])
            hit = re.search(r'^-- cursor: (.+)$', text, re.M)
            need(hit, 'fresh journal cursor')
            cursor = hit[1]
            r['kernel_cursor_before'] = cursor
            device('before')
            health('integer-before')
            kernel('kernel-after-prehealth', ['--after-cursor', cursor])
            r['property_query_attempts'] = 1
            run.save()
            text, diagnostic = run.run('property', [str(binary), PCI, '0xe20c'], env)
            from protocol import diagnostics
            need(not diagnostics(diagnostic)['severe_messages'], 'selected caps runtime diagnostics')
            observed = caps(text)
            r.update(observed)
            r['caps_stdout'] = text
            r['property_counters_scope'] = 'CAPS helper only; separate integer health probes allocate/copy/execute actual GPU work'
            kernel('kernel-after-property', ['--after-cursor', cursor])
            health('integer-after')
            device('after')
            kernel('kernel-after', ['--after-cursor', cursor])
            r['kernel_gate_passed'] = True
            common.validate_capacity(dict(r, passed=True, complete=True, active=False), q)
        need(pin(source) == r['property_source'], 'immutable unchanged CAPS source')
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as caught:
        error = caught
    finally:
        if cursor and run.owner.active is None:
            try:
                kernel('kernel-final', ['--after-cursor', cursor])
            except BaseException as caught:
                r['kernel_gate_error'] = repr(caught)
        code = run.finish(error)
    print(json.dumps({'passed': r['passed'], 'error': r.get('error'), 'property_binary': r.get('property_binary')}))
    return code


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
